verdicts.reason: A separates the can from its purple circle, so the circle is an empty blob behind the quote. The quote text runs over the circle's edge and is jammed against the right side of the canvas, the quote mark floats far from its text, and the attribution sits cramped under the quote. B keeps the original's structure (quote left, can on its circle at right) and its text is legible. However, the logo moved to the top, the quote block sits low with the attribution near the bottom edge, and the can is small and floats high in the circle.
